roles_project_name_unique.name: roles_project_name_unique
roles_project_name_unique.where: "roles"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."deleted_at" IS NULL

roles_system_shape.name: roles_system_shape
roles_system_shape.value: ("roles"."is_system" = ("roles"."key" IS NOT NULL)) AND (NOT "roles"."is_system" OR "roles"."project_id" IS NULL)

projects_trash_consistency.name: projects_trash_consistency
projects_trash_consistency.value:
("projects"."status" = 'TRASHED') = ("projects"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("projects"."status" = 'TRASHED') = ("projects"."previous_status" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("projects"."status" = 'TRASHED') = ("projects"."purge_eligible_at" IS NOT NULL)

stages_trash_consistency.name: stages_trash_consistency
stages_trash_consistency.value:
("stages"."status" = 'TRASHED') = ("stages"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("stages"."status" = 'TRASHED') = ("stages"."purge_eligible_at" IS NOT NULL)

financial_movements_house_shape.name: financial_movements_house_shape
financial_movements_house_shape.value:
("financial_movements"."type" = 'TRANSFER'
            AND "financial_movements"."house_id" IS NULL
            AND "financial_movements"."from_house_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "financial_movements"."to_house_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "financial_movements"."from_house_id" <> "financial_movements"."to_house_id")
          OR ("financial_movements"."type" <> 'TRANSFER'
            AND "financial_movements"."house_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "financial_movements"."from_house_id" IS NULL
            AND "financial_movements"."to_house_id" IS NULL)

financial_movements_direction_shape.name: financial_movements_direction_shape
financial_movements_direction_shape.value:
("financial_movements"."type" IN ('INITIAL_CAPITAL', 'DEPOSIT') AND "financial_movements"."direction" = 'CREDIT')
          OR ("financial_movements"."type" IN ('WITHDRAWAL', 'BET_PLACEMENT') AND "financial_movements"."direction" = 'DEBIT')
          OR ("financial_movements"."type" = 'BET_SETTLEMENT' AND "financial_movements"."direction" = 'CREDIT')
          OR ("financial_movements"."type" = 'EXTRAORDINARY' AND "financial_movements"."direction" IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT'))
          OR ("financial_movements"."type" = 'TRANSFER' AND "financial_movements"."direction" IS NULL)

financial_movements_reason_required.name: financial_movements_reason_required
financial_movements_reason_required.value:
"financial_movements"."type" NOT IN ('WITHDRAWAL', 'EXTRAORDINARY')
          OR ("financial_movements"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("financial_movements"."reason")) > 0)

withdrawal_requests_status_shape.name: withdrawal_requests_status_shape
withdrawal_requests_status_shape.value:
("withdrawal_requests"."status" = 'PENDING'
            AND "withdrawal_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "withdrawal_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "withdrawal_requests"."movement_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("withdrawal_requests"."status" = 'APPROVED'
            AND "withdrawal_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "withdrawal_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "withdrawal_requests"."movement_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("withdrawal_requests"."status" IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
            AND "withdrawal_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "withdrawal_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "withdrawal_requests"."movement_id" IS NULL)

bets_settlement_shape.name: bets_settlement_shape
bets_settlement_shape.value:
("bets"."status" = 'PENDING'
            AND "bets"."settled_at" IS NULL AND "bets"."official_realized_return" IS NULL)
          OR ("bets"."status" = 'LOST'
            AND "bets"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."official_realized_return" IS NULL)
          OR ("bets"."status" IN ('WON', 'VOID', 'CASHOUT')
            AND "bets"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "bets"."official_realized_return" IS NOT NULL
            AND "bets"."official_realized_return" >= 0)

bets_trash_consistency.name: bets_trash_consistency
bets_trash_consistency.value: ("bets"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("bets"."purge_eligible_at" IS NOT NULL)
